# FizzDragon

> AI-driven animation and IP co-creation platform. Users generate short-form animated series, storyboards, voice-overs and lip-sync videos from natural-language prompts; IP holders crowdsource production through co-creation "crews."

FizzDragon (operated by FizzDragon Pte Ltd, Singapore) runs a multi-agent
studio backend: a supervisor LLM (StoryOS) plans a series, then routes
work to specialised personas — storyboarder, role designer, scene
designer, prop designer — that produce the visual assets. Users assemble
episodes from those assets and ship to a public storefront.

The platform serves international users at https://fizzdragon.com and
Mainland China users at https://fizzdragon.fizzspace.cn. Both deployments
share one canonical brand identity.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://fizzdragon.com/): platform overview, featured IPs, hero stats.
- [About](https://fizzdragon.com/en-US/about): company background and mission.
- [News](https://fizzdragon.com/en-US/news): announcements, launch posts, partner news.
- [IPs](https://fizzdragon.com/en-US/ips): catalogue of all IPs on the platform.
- [Creators](https://fizzdragon.com/en-US/creators): directory of platform creators.
- [Courses](https://fizzdragon.com/en-US/courses): tutorials and learning paths for AI animation.
- [Crews](https://fizzdragon.com/en-US/crews): co-creation crews — recruitment and collaborative production.

## Localisation

The same site is also available in zh-CN (Simplified Chinese) and zh-HK
(Traditional Chinese). Substitute `/zh-CN/` or `/zh-HK/` for `/en-US/` in
any path. Mainland China users are served from the .cn mirror.

## Discoverability

- [XML sitemap](https://fizzdragon.com/sitemap.xml) — all routes × locales with hreflang.
- [robots.txt](https://fizzdragon.com/robots.txt) — explicit allowlist for AI crawlers.
- Per-page schema.org JSON-LD is present in the SSR HTML on every detail page (Article on /news/[id], CreativeWork + FAQPage on /ips/[id], Organization + WebSite on every page).
